newsitem.title: USA: Fed injects reserves via 10-day fixed system repos.
newsitem.headline: Fed injects reserves via 10-day fixed system repos.

text.p: The Federal Reserve, as expected, injected reserves into the banking system Monday via a round of 10-day fixed system system repurchase agreements.
The injection was seen as needed to handle what economists estimated was an underlying daily add need of about $9 billion.
The federal funds rate was trading right at the Fed's current target level of 5.25 percent, the same as prior to the intervention.
-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663
